trigger_predicate: question contains previous/next/before/after/directly before/directly after and names an anchor cell
constraint_text: If the question asks for a previous/next/before/after item, first locate the anchor row by exact cell match, then move by displayed row order and project the requested column; do not sort by a value column unless the question explicitly says highest/lowest/max/min.
required_action: anchor row -> displayed row move -> requested-column projection
forbidden_action: sorting by numeric/date/value columns for row-order wording
validation_slice: WTQ/SQA questions with previous|next|before|after plus an anchor entity

trigger_predicate: question asks for name/title/team/player/ship/school and table also has id/code/no./rank/seed/position columns
constraint_text: If the requested answer is a name/title/entity role, select the name/title/entity column; never output an identifier, code, number, rank, glyph, seed, or position column unless the question explicitly asks for that identifier role.
required_action: bind requested semantic role before selecting a cell
forbidden_action: returning nearby identifier/rank/code columns for entity-name questions
validation_slice: questions with entity-role terms and identifier/rank/code columns

trigger_predicate: headers or question contain rank/place/position/seed/pick/chart position
constraint_text: If the target column is rank/place/position/seed/pick/chart position, treat it as an ordinal where smaller usually means earlier/better; do not add, average, or compare it as a magnitude unless the question explicitly asks arithmetic over ranks.
forbidden_action: using ordinal columns as ordinary numeric magnitudes

trigger_predicate: sports/match/game table with score/result cells such as 18-12 or 14-14
constraint_text: If the question asks for a result/score cell, return the complete score string exactly as the table gives it; split or subtract the score only when the question asks for margin, difference, winner side, loser side, total, or comparison.
required_action: preserve complete score for lookup; parse only for explicit arithmetic/comparison
forbidden_action: dropping one side of a score or computing a margin for plain lookup
validation_slice: sports score/result lookup vs margin/difference questions

trigger_predicate: SQA position>0 and question contains these/those/their/of these/of those/among them/which one/of them
constraint_text: For follow-up wording that refers to prior answers, first restrict candidate rows to the previous answer set; do not scan the whole table until this active-set filter has been applied.
required_action: resolve previous answer set as row/entity filter before answering
forbidden_action: answering from rows outside the prior answer set
validation_slice: SQA follow-up turns with deictic references to prior answers

trigger_predicate: SQA follow-up asks for an attribute/property after prior entity set is established
constraint_text: After resolving the active rows from history, project only the newly requested column or role; do not repeat the previous answer role, return the matched value, or return whole rows.
forbidden_action: returning previous-turn values, whole rows, or unrequested neighboring columns
validation_slice: SQA follow-up turns asking for attributes of prior answers

trigger_predicate: SQA follow-up asks each/their/which ones/what dates over a multi-item active set
constraint_text: If the question asks one property for each active item, output one answer per active item in active-set order; do not collapse duplicates or stop after the first matching row.
required_action: preserve cardinality and order of active-set projection
forbidden_action: prefix-only lists, duplicate removal when duplicates correspond to distinct rows
validation_slice: SQA follow-ups with multi-answer gold or prior answer cardinality > 1

trigger_predicate: TableBench numerical question asks highest/lowest/average/sum/difference over a named metric column
constraint_text: Before any numeric operation, bind the exact metric column named by the question, including unit and year qualifiers; do not compute over a neighboring metric column with similar numbers.
forbidden_action: using adjacent numeric columns or gap/ratio columns instead of the requested metric
validation_slice: TableBench NumericalReasoning with multiple numeric metric columns

trigger_predicate: question asks average/sum/total over all rows or over a filtered subset
constraint_text: For average/sum/total questions, enumerate all rows satisfying the stated filters, then aggregate exactly those rows; do not aggregate only visible preview rows, headers, totals, or examples.
required_action: filter rows -> enumerate support -> aggregate support values
forbidden_action: partial aggregation over preview rows or inclusion of header/summary rows
validation_slice: TableBench aggregation and time-based calculation questions

trigger_predicate: question asks which/who/economy/entity had highest/lowest metric
constraint_text: If the question asks which entity has an extreme metric, sort/filter by the metric column but return the entity column; do not return the numeric metric value unless the question asks for the value.
forbidden_action: returning the metric value for which/who/entity questions
validation_slice: ranking questions where gold answer is an entity name

trigger_predicate: HiTab/statistical table with parent headers, subheaders, or table_source in {statcan, nsf, totto}
constraint_text: Before selecting a HiTab cell, resolve its full row-header path and column-header path, including parent group labels and unit rows; do not compare or project a cell using only its leaf header.
required_action: full header-path resolution before cell selection/comparison
validation_slice: HiTab examples with hierarchical headers or linked cell paths

trigger_predicate: HiTab aggregation contains pair-argmax/pair-argmin or question asks which of A or B is higher/lower/more/less
constraint_text: For pairwise comparison questions, compare only the two named candidates under the same indicator and unit, then return the winning candidate label from the table; do not return the compared numeric cell unless the question asks for the value.
required_action: candidate A/B binding -> same-indicator comparison -> winning label projection
forbidden_action: global max/min search or numeric-cell answer for label questions

trigger_predicate: HiTab answer formula or table cell contains a leading negative sign
constraint_text: If the referenced value or answer formula is negative, preserve the sign exactly unless the question asks for an absolute magnitude; do not strip, invert, or explain away the sign.
required_action: preserve signed value from reference cell/formula
forbidden_action: turning negative values positive without explicit absolute-value wording
validation_slice: HiTab opposite/negative formula examples and negative-value tables
